propositions: KNOWN_CAPABILITIES frozenset is empty and must register the multi-project-bridge capability to recognize it
A binary without the multi-project-bridge capability declared should raise StoreIncompatibleError on write and refuse to corrupt the store
A store with no .store-compat.json file should pass through as implicit legacy without behavioural change
Write operations should be gated by capability compatibility while read operations (list, show, search, fsck) remain available against incompatible stores
A malformed .store-compat.json record should raise an error rather than being treated as absent
